spanish: Y lo restante desde el aceite que sobre palma del sacerdote dará sobre cabeza del que se purifica, para expiar sobre él delante de Jehová.

findings.issue: Preverbal lo restante can be read as the subject of dará. The niphal participle is the fronted object; the qal imperfect 3ms subject is an implicit he who gives that remainder.
findings.spanishSpan: lo restante desde el aceite que sobre palma del sacerdote dará

notes: Remaining tokens match: partitive from the oil, verbless which-upon-palm, priest, head, hithpael the one purifying himself, piel infinitive to expiate upon him, before Jehová.
